```{r setup-payload-actg}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(kableExtra)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Payload location: NULL (default) resolves to the directory of the document
# being rendered (the manuscript when included; this fragment's folder for the
# standalone QC wrapper). Set an absolute path to read from a fixed results dir.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
payload_dir <- "_payloads/"

.pdir <- if (is.null(payload_dir)) {
  tryCatch(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), error = function(e) getwd())
} else {
  payload_dir
}
P <- readRDS(file.path(.pdir, "analysis_actg175_binary_multimethod_fixed_family_payload.rds"))

# ---- payload compatibility shim -------------------------------------------
# The analysis side renamed the refit-free quantities gate_* -> mr_*.  Accept
# either spelling so old and new payloads both render.
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || !length(a)) b else a

# NULL/length-0/non-finite -safe scalar extractor: never breaks vapply().
.num1 <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x %||% NA_real_))
  if (length(v) != 1L) NA_real_ else v
}

# ---- formatters -----------------------------------------------------------
fci <- function(e, l, u, d = 2) {
  ifelse(is.na(e), "\u2014", sprintf("%.*f (%.*f, %.*f)", d, e, d, l, d, u))
}
pt <- function(df, col) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0L || is.na(df[[col]][1])) "\u2014" else sprintf("%.2f", df[[col]][1])
}
fmt_label <- function(s) {
  # vector labels (e.g. c("cd40 >= 500", "drugs >= 0")) are conjoined with \cap
  if (is.null(s) || !length(s)) return("\u2014")
  s <- s[!is.na(s) & nzchar(trimws(s))]
  if (!length(s)) return("\u2014")
  opmap <- c("<=" = "\\le", ">=" = "\\ge", "<" = "<", ">" = ">", "==" = "=", "!=" = "\\ne")
  flip  <- c("<=" = ">", ">=" = "<", "<" = ">=", ">" = "<=", "==" = "!=", "!=" = "==")
  # round every numeric token (kills float-formatting noise, e.g. 84.369600000000005 -> 84.37)
  rnums <- function(x, d = 2) {
    g <- gregexpr("[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?", x, perl = TRUE)
    regmatches(x, g) <- lapply(regmatches(x, g), function(v)
      vapply(v, function(z) format(round(as.numeric(z), d), trim = TRUE,
                                   scientific = FALSE), character(1)))
    x
  }
  fmt_cut <- function(p) {
    p <- trimws(p); neg <- FALSE
    if (grepl("^!", p)) { neg <- TRUE; p <- trimws(sub("^!", "", p)) }      # leading complement
    p <- trimws(sub("\\}$", "", trimws(sub("^\\{", "", p))))            # strip one brace layer
    m <- regmatches(p, regexec("^(.*?)\\s*(<=|>=|==|!=|<|>)\\s*(.*)$", p))[[1]]
    if (length(m) == 4L && nzchar(trimws(m[2]))) {
      op <- m[3]; if (neg) op <- flip[[op]]                                 # !{x <= c} -> {x > c}
      sprintf("\\{%s %s %s\\}", trimws(m[2]), opmap[[op]], rnums(trimws(m[4])))
    } else {
      body <- rnums(p)
      if (neg) paste0("\\overline{\\{", body, "\\}}") else paste0("\\{", body, "\\}")
    }
  }
  parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(s, "\\s*(?:&|\u2229|\\\\cap|\\band\\b)\\s*", perl = TRUE)))
  parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
  paste0("$", paste(vapply(parts, fmt_cut, character(1)), collapse = " \\cap "), "$")
}
dur_bare <- function(sec) {
  if (is.null(sec) || !length(sec) || is.na(sec)) return("\u2014")
  if (sec < 1)  return(sprintf("%.2f seconds", sec))
  if (sec < 90) return(sprintf("%.1f seconds", sec))
  sprintf("%.1f minutes", sec / 60)
}

# ---- precomputed fragments ------------------------------------------------
fs_l   <- fmt_label(P$labels$fs)
grf_l  <- fmt_label(P$labels$grf)
dina_l <- fmt_label(P$labels$dina)

cap_actg <- paste0(
  "De-biased subgroup odds ratios for the ACTG175 trial (binary outcome, ",
  "OR scale); parenthetical values are 95% confidence ",
  "intervals. Here $\\widehat{H}$ is ", fs_l, " for FS, ", dina_l, " for DINA, and ",
  grf_l, " for GRF.")

B_txt     <- format(P$meta$B, big.mark = ",")
n_txt     <- format(P$meta$n_total, big.mark = ",")
# Cores ACTUALLY USED for the parallel sections, read from the analysis
# machine's payload.  Prefer machine$cores_used (the worker count); fall back
# to the older meta$cores = availableCores() for payloads written before the
# machine block existed.
.mi <- P$meta$machine
.cores_used <- if (!is.null(.mi) && length(.mi$cores_used) && isTRUE(is.finite(.mi$cores_used))) {
  .mi$cores_used
} else if (length(P$meta$cores) && isTRUE(is.finite(P$meta$cores))) {
  P$meta$cores
} else NA_integer_
cores_txt <- if (!is.na(.cores_used)) as.character(.cores_used) else "many"

# Optional hardware detail (CPU model + BLAS backend) from the analysis
# machine, to make the timing claim attributable.  Degrades to just the worker
# count when the machine block is absent.
.cpu_bits <- character(0)
if (!is.null(.mi)) {
  if (length(.mi$cpu_model) && !is.na(.mi$cpu_model)) .cpu_bits <- c(.cpu_bits, .mi$cpu_model)
  if (length(.mi$blas) && !is.na(.mi$blas)) {
    if (grepl("Accelerate|vecLib", .mi$blas))                 .cpu_bits <- c(.cpu_bits, "Accelerate BLAS")
    else if (grepl("openblas", .mi$blas, ignore.case = TRUE)) .cpu_bits <- c(.cpu_bits, "OpenBLAS")
    else if (grepl("mkl",      .mi$blas, ignore.case = TRUE)) .cpu_bits <- c(.cpu_bits, "MKL")
  }
}
cores_phrase <- if (!is.na(.cores_used) && length(.cpu_bits)) {
  sprintf("%d worker%s (%s)", .cores_used, if (.cores_used == 1L) "" else "s", paste(.cpu_bits, collapse = ", "))
} else if (!is.na(.cores_used)) {
  sprintf("%d worker%s", .cores_used, if (.cores_used == 1L) "" else "s")
} else {
  "many cores"
}

T1  <- P$table
.row <- function(meth, reg) T1[T1$method == meth & T1$region == reg, , drop = FALSE]
fsH   <- .row("FS", "H");   dinaH <- .row("DINA", "H"); grfH <- .row("GRF", "H")
fs_naive  <- pt(fsH, "naive_est");  fs_fb  <- pt(fsH, "fb_est");  fs_mr  <- pt(fsH, "mr_est")
dina_naive <- pt(dinaH, "naive_est"); dina_fb <- pt(dinaH, "fb_est"); dina_mr <- pt(dinaH, "mr_est")
grf_fb <- pt(grfH, "fb_est"); grf_mr <- pt(grfH, "mr_est")

cc <- P$extras$concordance
conc_n     <- if (!is.null(cc)) format(cc$n_agree, big.mark = ",") else "\u2014"
conc_pct   <- if (!is.null(cc)) sprintf("%.1f", cc$pct_agree) else "\u2014"
conc_kappa <- if (!is.null(cc) && !is.na(cc$kappa)) sprintf("%.2f", cc$kappa) else "\u2014"

hr <- P$extras$harm_rates
treated_pct <- if (!is.null(hr) && !is.na(hr$treated_pct)) sprintf("%.1f", hr$treated_pct) else "\u2014"
control_pct <- if (!is.null(hr) && !is.na(hr$control_pct)) sprintf("%.1f", hr$control_pct) else "\u2014"

bs <- vapply(P$meta$timings, function(m) .num1(m$boot_sec), numeric(1)); bs <- bs[is.finite(bs)]
# refit-free timing: mr_sec is the current name, gate_sec the legacy one
ms <- vapply(P$meta$timings, function(m) .num1(m$mr_sec %||% m$gate_sec), numeric(1)); ms <- ms[is.finite(ms)]
sp <- vapply(P$meta$timings, function(m) .num1(m$speedup), numeric(1)); sp <- sp[is.finite(sp)]
boot_min <- if (length(bs)) dur_bare(min(bs)) else "\u2014"
boot_max <- if (length(bs)) dur_bare(max(bs)) else "\u2014"
mr_min   <- if (length(ms)) dur_bare(min(ms)) else "\u2014"
mr_max   <- if (length(ms)) dur_bare(max(ms)) else "\u2014"
# Legacy aliases: other fragments in this document may still reference the old
# names.  Grep the tree for "gate_min|gate_max" and retire these once clean.
gate_min <- mr_min
gate_max <- mr_max
speedup_phrase <- if (length(sp)) {
  paste0("roughly ", format(round(min(sp)), big.mark = ","), " to ",
         format(round(max(sp)), big.mark = ","), " times faster")
} else {
  "far faster"
}
```

# ACTG175 application: the odds-ratio path {#sec-supp-actg175}

The odds-ratio companion to the GBSG analysis exercises the GLM path of the same
machinery (Section 1 of the main paper). AIDS Clinical Trials Group 175 [@hammer1996]
randomized $n =$ `r n_txt` patients to zidovudine plus
didanosine, the experimental arm, against didanosine monotherapy, the control; 
the dataset is accessed here through the `speff2trial`
package. The outcome here is an indicator of no CD4 improvement,
coded so that an odds ratio above the threshold signals harm. The candidate covariates
were the trial's baseline characteristics: age, weight (wtkg, $J=10$ cuts),
Karnofsky performance score (karnof), days of prior antiretroviral therapy (preanti), and baseline CD4 (cd40, $J=10$ cuts)
and CD8 (cd80) counts, together with binary indicators for hemophilia, homosexual activity, a
history of intravenous drug use, race, sex, and symptomatic status.  


```{r}
#| label: tbl-actg175-multimethod
#| tbl-cap: !expr cap_actg
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  sg_H <- "$\\widehat{H}$"; sg_Hc <- "$\\widehat{H}^{c}$"; pct_hdr <- "$n$ (\\%)"
} else {
  sg_H <- "\u0124"; sg_Hc <- "\u0124<sup>c</sup>"; pct_hdr <- "<i>n</i> (%)"
}
sg <- ifelse(T1$region == "H", sg_H, sg_Hc)
actg <- data.frame(
  Method = ifelse(T1$region == "H", T1$method, ""),
  SG     = sg,
  n      = sprintf("%d (%d)", as.integer(T1$n), as.integer(T1$pct)),
  Naive  = fci(T1$naive_est, T1$naive_lo, T1$naive_hi),
  FB     = fci(T1$fb_est, T1$fb_lo, T1$fb_hi),
  Mult   = fci(T1$mr_est, T1$mr_lo, T1$mr_hi),
  check.names = FALSE
)
colnames(actg) <- c("Method", "SG", pct_hdr, "Naive", "Full bootstrap", "Multiplier")
kbl(actg, booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = "lccccc", linesep = "") |>
  kable_styling() |>
  row_spec(2, extra_latex_after = "\\midrule", extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid #adadad") |>
  row_spec(4, extra_latex_after = "\\midrule", extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid #adadad")
```

The results displayed in @tbl-actg175-multimethod are as follows. FS and GRF identify similar high-weight and high-CD4 regions `r fmt_label(P$labels$fs)` 
and `r fmt_label(P$labels$grf)`, respectively — close but not
identical cuts, agreeing on `r conc_n` of `r n_txt` patients (`r conc_pct`%, Cohen's
$\kappa = `r conc_kappa`$) — where `r treated_pct`% of treated patients show no CD4
improvement against `r control_pct`% on control, and the naive odds ratio of
`r fs_naive` corrects to `r fs_fb` (FB) and `r fs_mr` (MR) but stays well above the threshold. DINA selects `r dina_l`, whose apparent harm substantially diminishes under correction — naive `r dina_naive` to `r dina_fb` (FB) and `r dina_mr` (MR).  

As noted above there is considerable overlap between the identified subgroups of FS and GRF, and both corrections 
remain elevated (above $1.0$) but there are differences in magnitude between the FB (`r fs_fb` [FS] vs `r grf_fb` [GRF]) and MR corrections (`r fs_mr` [FS] vs `r grf_mr` [GRF]).

The cost advantage holds for this larger study — the full bootstrap in minutes against the refit-free procedure in seconds (`r speedup_phrase` across the three identifiers).
